theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpo_cyl_support
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → ∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)) (S : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1) → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), IsCompact X.support → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1), tsupport (S ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) ⊆ {x : Euclid N | ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) : Euclid (N + 1)) ∈ tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1))}) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1), Z ω = X (S ω)) → IsCompact Z.support ∧ Z.support ⊆ {y : Euclid (N + 1) | ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ x ∈ X.support, y = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))}
